blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Omni-modal large language models (Omni-LLMs) typically process large numbers of multimodal tokens from audio-visual inputs, incurring substantial computational costs and a large memory footprint for the key-value (KV) cache. Aggressive token pruning can alleviate this problem while maintaining competitive performance on multiple-choice tasks, which require only a single option as output. However, we observe substantial quality degradation when generating long-form, open-ended responses. We attribute this gap to query-guided selection, which can retain sufficient evidence for answer selection while discarding details needed for comprehensive generation. This motivates reducing overlapping information across tokens, termed structural redundancy, while preserving diverse content. However, the retained representations may still contain precision redundancy due to unnecessarily high numerical precision in their cached values. To address these two levels of redundancy in token representations, we introduce a training-free framework named R$^2$-Omni. First, Structure-Aware Token Consolidation (STC) consolidates redundant representations using spatiotemporal similarity in video and local continuity in audio. Then, Semantic-Sensitivity Guided Precision Allocation (SSPA) allocates value precision to the retained representations according to the estimated reduction in attention-output error under quantized keys, with query attention and audio-visual alignment providing a semantic prior. Extensive experiments on long-form generation benchmarks demonstrate an average 5.0$\times$ reduction in the memory footprint while preserving 97.98% of baseline generation quality and achieving a 1.48$\times$ end-to-end speedup, highlighting the benefits of jointly reducing structural and precision redundancy.
blocks.zh: Omni-modle大型语言模型(Omni-LLMs)一般会从视听投入中处理出大量多模式符号,产生大量的计算成本和对密钥值缓存(KV)的巨大内存足迹. 侵略性的代币挤压可以缓解这一问题,同时在多选择任务上保持竞争性表现,这些任务只需要一个作为产出的单一选项. 然而,我们看到,在产生长期、开放的反应时,质量严重退化。 我们将此差距归结为查询指导选择,这种选择可以保留足够的答案选择证据,同时丢弃全面生成所需的细节. 这鼓励减少各种标志(称为结构冗余)的重叠信息,同时保留不同的内容。 但是,保留的陈述可能仍然含有精度冗余,因为其缓存值数字精度不必要地很高。 为了解决象征性表示的这两个冗余级别,我们引入了一个名为R$^2$-Omni的无培训框架。 首先,结构-Aware Token 综合(STC)利用视频的瞬间相近性和音频的局部连续性来整合冗余表示。 然后,语义-敏感度导精度分配(SPA)根据被分解的密钥下注意力输出误差的估计减少,将数值精度分配到所保留的表示上,而查询注意力和视听对接提供语义前. 对长式生成基准的广泛试验表明,记忆足迹平均减少5.0美元,同时保留了基准生成质量的97.98%并实现了1.48美元到末端加速,突出了联合减少结构冗余和精密冗余的好处。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Omni-modal large language models (Omni-LLMs) [ 1 , 2 , 3 ] can jointly process text, video, and audio, enabling powerful audio-visual reasoning and open-ended generation.
These capabilities support diverse applications, including real-time multimodal assistants [ 4 , 5 ] and complex video understanding tasks [ 6 , 7 ] .
However, long audio-visual inputs introduce many multimodal tokens, substantially increasing prefill computation and the memory footprint during autoregressive decoding.
blocks.zh:
Omni-module大型语言模型(Omni-LLMs)[1,2,3]可以联合处理文本,视频,和音频,使强大的视听推理和可开放的生成成为可能.
这些能力支持各种应用,包括实时多模式助理[4,5]和复杂的视频理解任务[6,7].
然而,长长的视听投入引入了许多多式符号,大大增加了预填计算和自递解码过程中的内存足迹.

blocks.en: Token pruning [ 8 , 9 , 10 , 11 , 12 ] effectively reduces these costs by removing redundant tokens from the multimodal input. These methods can substantially reduce token counts while maintaining strong performance on multiple-choice benchmarks [ 13 , 14 , 15 , 16 ] , even under aggressive compression. However, this behavior does not extend equally to long-form generation. As shown in Fig. 1 (a), dense-captioning quality degrades much faster than multiple-choice performance as the pruning ratio increases, revealing the limitations of these methods on open-ended tasks that better reflect real-world use.
blocks.zh: Token pruning [8, 9, 10, 11, 12] 通过从多式输入中去除多余的符号,有效地减少了这些费用. 这些方法可以大幅度地减少象征性的计数,同时在多重选择基准上保持强效[13,14,15,16],即使在激烈的压缩下也是如此. 然而,这种行为并没有同等地延伸到长形一代. 如图1(a)所显示,密集的封装质量会随着穿插比例的提高而比多选择性能降解快得多,揭示出这些方法对可更好地反映现实世界用途的开放式任务的局限性.

blocks.en:
We attribute this gap to query-guided token pruning, where methods typically use query attention to assess token importance for the current question and discard tokens with low scores. For multiple-choice tasks, this approach can retain sufficient evidence to identify the correct option while discarding other irrelevant details.
In contrast, long-form generation is an open-ended task and requires broader information coverage, including more events, attributes, and temporal details beyond the evidence needed for a single decision.
Tokens receiving low attention scores from the initial query may still contain unique information needed later in generation, so directly removing them can significantly degrade performance. This suggests that we should target only intrinsic structural redundancy , such as spatial similarity, temporal persistence, and local audio continuity, for token reduction while preserving diverse multimodal content for subsequent generation.
blocks.zh:
我们将此差距归结为查询引导的符号搜索,其中方法通常使用查询注意力来评估当前问题的符号重要性并丢弃分数低的符号. 对于多选择任务,这种方法可以保留足够的证据来识别正确的选项,同时丢弃其他无关的细节.
相形之下,长式生成是一项没有限制的任务,需要更广泛的信息覆盖面,包括超出单一决定所需证据的更多事件、属性和时间细节。
从初始查询中接收到低关注分数的托肯可能仍然包含生成后需要的独特信息,因此直接去除它们可以显著地降解性能. 这表明,我们应仅针对内在的结构冗余,如空间相似性、时间持久性和当地音频连续性,以示减少,同时为下一代保留多种多模式内容。

blocks.en:
However, even after structural redundancy is reduced, the retained tokens may still be represented at unnecessarily high numerical precision.
As illustrated in Fig. 1 (b), reducing the precision of their cached values can further decrease the memory footprint while preserving sufficient information to successfully complete the task.
This precision redundancy therefore provides an additional opportunity for compression without discarding more tokens [ 17 , 18 , 19 , 20 , 21 ] . Taken together, these observations reveal two forms of redundancy in token representations: overlapping information across tokens and excess numerical precision in each token’s cached value.
blocks.zh:
然而,即使在结构冗余减少之后,保留符号仍可能以不必要的高精确度表示。
如图1(b)所示,降低其缓存值的精度可进一步减少内存足迹,同时保留足够的信息以成功完成任务.
因此,这种精密冗余为压缩提供了额外的机会,而不会丢弃更多的符号[17、18、19、20、21]。 总而言之,这些意见揭示了象征性表示的两种冗余形式:符号之间的信息重叠和每个符号的缓存值的数值精确度过高。

blocks.en: To address this problem, we propose R 2 -Omni , a training-free framework that jointly reduces structural and precision redundancy in the token representations of Omni-LLMs. Specifically, we first introduce Structure-Aware Token Consolidation (STC) to consolidate overlapping representations based on spatiotemporal similarity in video and local continuity in audio, preserving diverse information while effectively shortening the input sequence. Then, to address precision redundancy within the retained representations, we design Semantic-Sensitivity Guided Precision Allocation (SSPA). It uses query attention and audio-visual alignment as a semantic prior, allocating value precision under a memory budget to minimize attention-output error under quantized keys. Through this coordinated design, STC and SSPA exploit the redundancy across input sequence and cached values in Omni-LLMs, while preserving multimodal information essential for long-form generation.
blocks.zh: 为了解决这一问题,我们提议采用R 2-Omni(无培训框架),这个框架将共同减少Omni-LLMs符号表达中的结构和精度冗余。 具体地说,我们首先引入了结构-Aware Token综合(STC),以整合基于视频相近性与音频局部连续性的重叠表达,在有效缩短输入序列的同时,保留了多种信息. 然后,为了解决保留表述中的精度冗余问题,我们设计了语义-敏感度导精度分配(SPA). 它使用查询注意力和视听对齐作为语义前置,在内存预算下分配值精度,以将注意力输出出错最小化在被量化的密钥下. 通过这种协调设计,STC和SPA利用Omni-LLMs中输入序列和缓存值之间的冗余,同时保存长式生成所必需的多式信息.

blocks.en: Extensive experiments on long-form generation benchmarks [ 6 , 22 , 7 ] demonstrate an average 5.0 × \times reduction in memory footprint while preserving 97.98% of baseline generation quality and achieving a 1.48 × \times end-to-end speedup, highlighting the practical benefits of jointly addressing both forms of redundancy.
blocks.zh: 关于长式生成基准[6,22,7]的广泛实验显示,记忆足迹平均会减少5.0×\时间,同时保留基准生成质量的97.98%并实现1.48×\时间的端到端加速,突出了联合解决两种冗余形式的实际好处.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Early token pruning methods mainly target VLMs through attention-guided pruning, informative-token selection, and dynamic sparsification [ 23 , 24 , 25 ] . Another line of work exploits token similarity to merge redundant video representations [ 26 , 27 , 28 , 29 ] . With the emergence of Omni-LLMs [ 1 , 2 , 3 ] , recent studies have extended compression to joint audio-video inputs. Omni-specific methods span modality-asymmetric guidance, where one modality guides compression of the other [ 8 , 9 ] , and more joint or modality-adaptive audio-visual selection [ 30 , 10 ] . Recently, compression has expanded across the LLM boundary, coordinating pre-LLM structural reduction with layer-wise semantic refinement inside the LLM [ 11 , 12 ] .

blocks.en:
KV-cache quantization has progressed from fixed-precision low-bit schemes
toward outlier-aware, token-adaptive, and mixed-precision designs.
Existing methods exploit K/V distribution asymmetry, preserve salient or
outlier components, or adapt precision according to token, layer, or query
importance [ 17 , 18 , 31 , 21 , 32 ] .
More recently, these techniques have been extended to multimodal models,
including ultra-low-bit quantization for VideoLLMs, dynamic multimodal
quantization, and extreme quantization across language, vision-language, and
Omni-LLMs [ 33 , 34 , 20 ] .
In contrast, our method evaluates precision upgrades directly in the
attention-output space and allocates value precision conditioned on both
quantized keys and joint multimodal semantic evidence.

blocks.en:
Several works jointly explore token and KV compression.
VLM methods reduce prefill computation and KV storage through token sparsification or temporal compression [ 25 , 26 ] , combine streaming token reduction with low-bit memory [ 35 ] , or couple token pruning with model and sometimes KV quantization [ 36 , 37 ] .
Omni-specific methods also prune audio-video tokens and their corresponding KV entries [ 38 ] .
These approaches focus on VLMs, model quantization, or token eviction.
To the best of our knowledge, R 2 -Omni is the first framework to jointly reduce structural redundancy in audio-video tokens and precision redundancy in the resulting KV cache for efficient Omni-LLMs.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We presented R 2 -Omni, a training-free framework that jointly reduces structural and precision redundancy for efficient long-form generation in Omni-LLMs. STC consolidates overlapping audio-visual representations while preserving diverse content, and SSPA allocates value precision according to attention-output sensitivity under quantized keys, guided by a multimodal semantic prior. Across three Omni-LLMs and three long-form generation benchmarks, R 2 -Omni achieves an average 5.0 × 5.0\times KV-cache compression while retaining 97.98 % 97.98\% of baseline generation quality. It also delivers a 1.48 × 1.48\times end-to-end speedup in our long-context efficiency evaluation. These results highlight the benefits of jointly reducing overlapping representations and excess numerical precision while preserving the multimodal information needed for comprehensive generation.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了R 2-Omni,这是一个无培训的框架,它共同减少了Omni-LLMs中高效长式生成的结构与精度冗余. STC合并了相重叠的视听表现,同时保留了不同的内容,SPA根据被量化的密钥下的注意力输出敏感性分配了价值精度,并以多式语义前作指导. 通过三个Omni-LLM和三个长式生成基准,R 2-Omni在保持97.98%的基线生成质量的同时,实现了平均5.0× 5.0\tims KV-cache压缩. 它还在长文效率评价中提供了1.48×1.48\时间的端到端加速. 这些结果突出表明了共同减少重叠表述和超精确数字的好处,同时保留全面生成所需的多模式信息。

blocks.en: The achievable compression of R 2 -Omni depends in part on its precision allocation strategy, which shapes the balance between memory efficiency and generation quality. This balance may vary across models and application settings, leaving room for further refinement of the framework. Future work will extend R 2 -Omni to a broader range of model architectures and explore its application in agentic systems with more diverse generation requirements.
blocks.zh: R2-Omni的可实现压缩部分取决于它的精密分配策略,它塑造了内存效率和生成质量之间的平衡. 这种平衡可能因模型和应用设置而异,为进一步完善框架留有余地。 今后的工作将把R2-Omni扩展至更广泛的模型架构,并探索其在具有更多样化的生成要求的代理系统中的应用.

blocks.en: We evaluate all token pruning methods on Qwen2.5-Omni-3B under the same model and evaluation settings. As shown in Table 6 , moderate token pruning largely preserves model quality, whereas aggressive pruning causes substantial degradation, particularly on dense-captioning tasks. At pruning ratios of 70–80%, the Correct rate on Video-SALMONN 2 drops markedly across all methods, while the degradation on DailyOmni is comparatively smaller. This indicates that multiple-choice tasks can often be solved using a limited subset of salient evidence, whereas dense captioning requires retaining substantially more fine-grained visual information. These results support our motivation that aggressive token pruning may remove details that are unnecessary for answering a specific question but remain important for comprehensive long-form generation.

Only the page assignment is shared across a layer group; cache values

During decoding, new queries, keys, and values undergo the corresponding
position handling and Hadamard transforms.
New KV states enter Recent-FP in BF16.
The mixed-precision Triton kernel reads the packed historical pools and
Recent-FP, dequantizes blocks on chip, and combines their local softmax
statistics into a single globally normalized readout.
The inverse value transform is applied before the output projection.
The full historical cache is not materialized in BF16 during decoding,
although prefill calibration and packing temporarily use floating-point KV.

Recent-FP is initially empty and has a default capacity of 128 tokens.
When full and another token must be appended, its aligned 128-token block
is transferred to history using INT4 keys and INT2 values.
This is blockwise flushing, not a sliding window that always retains
128 floating-point tokens.
Prompt-page assignments remain fixed during decoding, and transferred
generated tokens do not trigger semantic rescoring or reallocation.
When space is available, appending the current KV state is fused with
attention readout.
All scoring, allocation, and packing overheads are included in TTFT.

blocks.en:
KIVI and OTT do not natively support Qwen2.5-Omni or the internal Qwen3 model
used by MiniCPM-o.
We denote our model-side adaptations as KIVI-OM and OTT-OM.
The multimodal encoders, processor, and generation interface remain unchanged.
Only text self-attention and cache management are adapted.

由MiniCPM-o使用.

多式联运编码器、处理器和生成界面保持不变。

blocks.en:
Prompt prefilling follows the original pipeline of Omni-LLMs with FlashAttention-2.
The adapter applies the model’s native Q/K/V projections, Qwen2.5 multimodal
RoPE or Qwen3 QK normalization and RoPE, and then converts the completed cache
to the baseline’s packed format.
During decoding, it maps Qwen GQA heads to the layout expected by the packed
operator and reconnects the resulting attention output to the original output
projection.
A thin cache wrapper exposes the packed state through the Transformers cache
interface.

随Omni-LLMs的原始管道而迅速进行预填,并带有闪存-2。
适配器应用该模型的原生Q/K/V预测,Quen2.5多式
RoPE 或 Quen3 QK 正常化和 RoPE, 然后转换已完成的缓存
改为基准的组合格式。
在解码时, 它将 Quen GQA 头像映射到 被打包的布局
运算符并重新连接所产生的注意输出到原输出
预测。

For Qwen2.5-Omni-7B, queries are scaled by 1 / d 1/\sqrt{d} before the FP16 packed
QK readout.
This is algebraically equivalent to scaling the completed logits and avoids
FP16 overflow without modifying the cache format or CUDA kernels.
Dense SDPA and FlashAttention-2 readouts are retained only as correctness
references; efficiency results use native packed decode.

引用; 效率结果使用本地打包解码 。

KIVI-OM preserves KIVI’s asymmetric quantization: keys are quantized
per-channel over token groups, while values are quantized per-token over
channel groups.
Packing and low-bit readout use KIVI’s Triton quantizer and CUDA GEMV.
The adapter maintains the full-precision residual cache, appends newly
generated states, and flushes complete groups into the packed cache.

KIVI-OM 保留了 KIVI 的不对称定量: 键被定量
每个频道超过符号组,而每个键的值被量化
频道组.
包装和低位读出使用KIVI的Triton分量器和CUDA GEMV.
适配器维持全精度的剩余缓存,新附加
生成状态,然后冲出组合完成到已打包的缓存中。

blocks.en:
The reported Qwen2.5-Omni-3B experiments use the established
Qwen-compatible KIVI transition in which K and V share the same Recent-FP
boundary and aligned groups are quantized together.
The released KIVI state transition is also exposed as a separate audit mode.
We therefore report this baseline as KIVI-OM rather than claiming native
Qwen2.5-Omni support.

报告的Quen2.5-Omni-3B实验使用了既定的
K和V在最近-FP中共享的与KIVI兼容的 Quen-compatiable KIVI 过渡
边界组和对等组合并。
发布的KIVI状态过渡也作为单独的审计模式被曝光.
因此,我们将这一基线报告为KIVI-OM,而不是声称是本地人。
文2.5-奥姆尼支持.

blocks.en:
OTT-OM directly invokes the released OTT cache update routine for residual
flushing, outlier scoring, traced-token updates, replacement, and K/V packing.
Its Triton packer and CUDA GEMV are imported from the upstream implementation
without modification.
The adapter only translates the Qwen cache to the tuple consumed by the
released update routine and maps Qwen GQA heads to the kernel layout.

blocks.en:
Traced K/V states are restored in full precision during attention, while the
remaining cache is read from the packed representation.
Layer-wise tracing rules, residual size, outlier count, and auxiliary capacity

We report the resulting method as OTT-OM because the interface to Omni-LLMs,
multimodal positional encoding, and GQA integration are provided by our
adapter.

blocks.en: Appendix C Long-Form Generation Benchmarks
blocks.zh: 附录C

blocks.en: The experiments are conducted on the following long-form generation benchmarks.
blocks.zh: 实验是根据下列长式生成基准进行的。

blocks.en:
The video-SALMONN2 testset [ 6 ] is a long-form generation benchmark designed to evaluate the completeness and factual accuracy of detailed video descriptions.
It contains 483 videos spanning 14 diverse domains, with durations ranging from 30 to 60 seconds and an average duration of approximately 51 seconds.
Each video is annotated with a set of fine-grained audio-visual events that serve as reference information for evaluating generated captions.
The official evaluation employs an LLM-based judge to identify missed, incorrect, and hallucinated events, from which the event error rate (EER) is computed.
We report the Correct rate and EER to jointly measure information preservation and generation accuracy.
blocks.zh:
视频-SALMONN2测试集[6]是一个长式生成基准,旨在评价详细视频描述的完整性和事实准确性.
它包含483个视频,涵盖14个不同领域,持续时间从30至60秒不等,平均持续时间约为51秒.
每一段录像都附有一套精细的视听活动,作为评价所生成字幕的参考信息。
官方评价使用基于LLM的法官来识别错失、不正确和有幻觉的事件,从中计算出事件出错率。
我们报告正确率和EER,以便联合测量信息保存和生成的准确性。

blocks.en:
LongVALE [ 22 ] is used as a long-form generation benchmark for temporally grounded descriptions of long videos.
The full dataset contains approximately 8.4K long videos with 105K omni-modal events, where each event is annotated with precise temporal boundaries and detailed relation-aware captions covering visual, audio, and speech information.
Its evaluation split consists of 1,171 videos containing 13,867 annotated omni-modal events, corresponding to 75.6 hours of video.
LongVALE supports three fine-grained tasks: omni-modal temporal video grounding, dense video captioning, and segment captioning.
Following the official Omni-DVC evaluation protocol, we use SODA-C to assess the overall quality of temporally grounded dense descriptions.
blocks.zh:
LongVALE [22] 被作为长式生成基准,用于基于时间的长视频描述.
完整的数据集包含约8.4K长视频,包含105K全方位模式活动,其中每场活动都附加了精确的时间界限和详细的关联感说明,涵盖视觉,音频和语音信息.
其评价分为1,171个视频,包含13,867个注解的全方位模式活动,相当于75.6小时的视频.
LongVALE支持三项精细的配乐任务:全模式时段视频平地,密集的视频字幕和片段字幕.
跟随官员 Omni-DVD评价协议,我们使用SODA-C来评估基于时间的密集描述的整体质量.

blocks.en:
OmniDCBench [ 7 ] is a human-annotated long-form generation benchmark that requires Omni-LLMs to generate continuous, fine-grained, and structured audio-visual narratives with explicit temporal boundaries.
It contains 1,122 high-resolution videos annotated by experts with cinematography knowledge, with an average annotation length of approximately 995 words per video.
The annotations follow a six-dimensional structural schema covering audio-visual events, background and environment, camera state, shot editing, dialogue, and acoustic cues.
This long-form generation benchmark jointly evaluates multi-scene temporal segmentation and detailed caption quality.
We report SodaM for the overall quality.
blocks.zh:
OmniDC Bench [7] 是人类附加说明的长式生成基准,需要 Omni-LLMs生成连续,精细,结构化的有明确时间界限的视听叙事.
它包含1,122个高清视频,由有电影学知识的专家作注释,每个视频的平均注释长度约为995个字.
说明采用六维结构方案,涵盖视听事件、背景和环境、相机状态、镜头编辑、对话和声调提示。
这种长式生成基准共同评价多场时间分解和详细标题的质量。

blocks.en: Appendix D Evaluated Omni-LLMs

blocks.en:
Efficient use of pretrained multimodal models supports broader
accessibility, including adaptation to scientific
domains [ 43 ] .
We briefly describe the two model architectures used in our experiments.
blocks.zh:
高效使用经过预先培训的多式联运模式有助于更广泛地使用
包括适应科学
域 [43].
我们简要描述了我们实验中使用的两个模型建筑.

blocks.en:
Qwen2.5-Omni [ 1 ] adopts a Thinker–Talker
architecture. The Thinker integrates visual and audio encoders with
a language backbone for multimodal understanding and text generation,
while the Talker generates speech from the Thinker’s representations.
Audio and video tokens are temporally interleaved and processed with
time-aligned multimodal rotary position embeddings.
Our experiments use the Thinker, applying STC before language-model
prefill and SSPA to its historical KV cache.
blocks.zh:
Quen2.5-Omni [1] 采用智者-塔尔克
结构。 思维器将视觉和音频编码器与
多式联运理解和文本生成的语言主干,
而谈话者则从思想家的陈述中产生演讲。
音频和视频代号在时间上相互连接和处理
时间相配多式旋转位置嵌入。
我们的实验是用思维器,在语言模型之前应用STC
预填和 SPA 到其历史 KV 缓存。

blocks.en:
MiniCPM-o-4.5 [ 3 ] combines a SigLIP visual encoder,
a Whisper audio encoder, and a Qwen3-8B language backbone.
A visual resampler and an audio projector convert modality features
into embeddings for joint processing with text.
Dedicated speech decoders support audio generation.
R 2 -Omni applies STC to the fused input embeddings and SSPA to the
language backbone’s historical KV cache.
blocks.zh:
MiniCPM-o-4.5 [3]结合了SigLIP视觉编码器,
(单位:千美元) 华声音频编码器,并有Qwen3-8B语言骨干.
图像重印器和音频投影器转换模式特性
与文本进行联合处理。
专用语音解码器支持音频生成.
区域 2-Omni将STC应用于引信输入嵌入,将SPA应用于
语言主干线的历史 KV 缓存 。

We provide qualitative examples to complement the quantitative evaluation and

generated descriptions preserve reference-supported events and semantic details
throughout the input sequence.

说明不同的压缩策略如何影响多式信息
保留。 我们不是比较标题长度,而是着重于是否
生成的描述保存参考支持的事件和语义细节

blocks.en: E.3 Factuality under Compression
blocks.zh: E.3 压缩下的事实

blocks.en:
This example examines factuality preservation under multimodal compression.
As shown in Figure 8 , R 2 -Omni preserves the core
interaction while introducing no hallucinated events according to the official
event-level judge. The judge records zero hallucinations for both BF16 and
R 2 -Omni, compared with five for OmniZip and four for OScaR.

blocks.en: E.4 Comparison Between STC and Token Pruning
blocks.zh: E.4 STC和Token Pruning之间的比较

blocks.en:
This example compares STC with token pruning at the same final memory footprint.
As shown in Figure 9 , STC preserves substantially more of the
original visual information after compression, while token pruning leads to a
coarser representation and loses more fine-grained content.
blocks.zh:
这个例子将STC与同为最终记忆足迹的标志性搜索相提并论.
如图9所示,科技委员会保留了更多的
压缩后的原始视觉信息,而符号搜索则导致
coarser代表并损失了更多的精细内容.

blocks.en:
This comparison shows that the advantage of STC does not come from using a
larger memory budget, but from preserving a denser set of useful visual
evidence with the same final memory footprint. This allows R 2 -Omni to maintain
richer content with the same overall memory footprint.
blocks.zh:
这种比较表明,STC的优势并非来自使用一种
更大的内存预算,但从保存更密集的一组有用的视觉
具有相同最终记忆足迹的证据。 这允许 R 2 - Omni 维护
内容更丰富 整体记忆足迹相同。
